title: Freeze MVP product shape and operating assumptions
purpose: Turn the research assumptions into explicit MVP decisions before implementation starts.
scope: Choose first product shape: developer VM, cloud VM, or explicitly scoped dual-track.
Fix first distro target and hardware assumptions.
Decide external LLM policy for MVP: disabled, optional, or required for non-critical planning.
Record MVP non-goals so Firecracker productionization, seL4/Genode, HA, and multi-tenant work do not leak into the first slice.
acceptance_criteria: The selected MVP shape names the primary user, environment, and first three workflows.
All open assumptions from research.md lines 23-31 are accepted, rejected, or deferred.
The decision document includes explicit non-goals and a change-control rule for scope expansion.
verification: Review decision document for unresolved TODO markers.
Confirm downstream tasks reference the selected product shape.
risk_notes: Starting implementation before this task completes will create architecture churn.
